This appears to be from the GPT-1 paper (Radford et al., 2018, *"Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training"*), Figure 2 (left). That figure shows how RACE and MultiNLI accuracy change as more pre-trained layers are transferred.

I can't give you exact numbers from memory with confidence. The paper reports this result only as a plot, not a table. My rough recollection of the RACE dev curve is:

- **0 layers transferred:** low, roughly around 40%.
- **All 12 layers transferred:** roughly 58–60%, close to the model's reported RACE test score of 59.0%.

The text itself only quantifies the MultiNLI side. It says transferring embeddings helps and that each layer adds further benefit, "up to 9% for full transfer on MultiNLI." It doesn't state specific RACE values.

Your working directory is empty, so I couldn't check the figure. If you share the PDF or the figure, I can read the values more precisely.
